notes.title: Working on Scary Humans’ next update
notes.content:
At Gabhel Games, we are aware that [b]a game must be in constant evolution and the community’s opinions are crucial to the product’s success[/b]. That is why Scary Humans will keep evolving and improving, getting everything on point, adding players’ suggestions, including new game modes… 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26637949/072ba50f4950fc340a6cf3f783e06cc64016ba1c.png[/img]

[b]These will all be free updates for all our players who have relied on the game.[/b] If you have any suggestions, queries or anything else to point out, please send them through either Steam’s community or to hello@scaryhumans.com. [b]Scary Humans is not our game, but your game[/b].

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26637949/f6346458995f20441000aadea94ac9f6baaddaba.png[/img]

And don't forget to follow us on Twitter at [url=https://twitter.com/scaryhumans]@scaryhumans[/url].
